RFP 01
Smart Hospital Management System
RFP Number
MOH-RFP-2026-001
Issuing Organization
Ministry of Health (MOH)
Issue Date
May 2026
Proposal Submission Deadline
15 June 2026
1. Executive Summary
The Ministry of Health (MOH) invites qualified vendors to submit proposals for the implementation of a
Smart Hospital Management System.
The objective of this project is to establish a centralized healthcare management platform that improves
patient care, automates hospital operations, enhances medical workflows, and provides advanced reporting
and analytics capabilities.
The selected vendor shall provide implementation, integration, training, deployment, and support services.
2. Background
Healthcare organizations currently operate multiple disconnected systems across patient registration,
appointments, billing, pharmacy, and clinical services.
Current challenges include:
•
Manual administrative processes
•
Long patient waiting times
1
•
Limited reporting capabilities
•
Fragmented patient information
•
Inefficient appointment management
•
Lack of operational visibility
The Ministry seeks a unified healthcare platform that improves operational efficiency and patient
experience.
3. Project Objectives
Business Objectives
•
Improve patient satisfaction.
•
Improve healthcare service quality.
•
Reduce operational costs.
•
Improve resource utilization.
Operational Objectives
•
Automate hospital workflows.
•
Improve appointment scheduling.
•
Improve patient record management.
•
Enhance operational visibility.
Strategic Objectives
•
Support healthcare digital transformation.
•
Improve data-driven decision-making.
•
Enable future AI healthcare initiatives.
•
Improve healthcare governance.
4. Scope of Work
4.1 Patient Management
The platform shall provide:
•
Patient Registration
•
Electronic Medical Records (EMR)
•
Patient History Management
•
Patient Portal
•
Insurance Information Management
2
4.2 Appointment Management
The solution shall support:
•
Appointment Scheduling
•
Doctor Availability Management
•
Appointment Reminders
•
Online Booking
•
Waiting List Management
4.3 Clinical Management
The platform shall provide:
•
Clinical Documentation
•
Treatment Plans
•
Diagnosis Management
•
Laboratory Integration
•
Radiology Integration
4.4 Pharmacy Management
The solution shall support:
•
Medication Management
•
Prescription Processing
•
Inventory Tracking
•
Drug Interaction Alerts
4.5 Billing & Financial Management
The platform shall provide:
•
Billing Management
•
Insurance Claims Processing
•
Payment Tracking
•
Financial Reporting
3
4.6 Reporting & Analytics
The solution shall support:
•
Executive Dashboards
•
Operational Reports
•
KPI Monitoring
•
Healthcare Analytics
•
Regulatory Reporting
5. Technical Requirements
Platform Requirements
The solution shall be:
•
Cloud Enabled
•
Highly Available
•
API Enabled
•
Mobile Accessible
•
Scalable
Integration Requirements
The platform shall integrate with:
•
Laboratory Information Systems
•
Radiology Systems
•
Insurance Providers
•
Government Health Platforms
•
SMS Services
Security Requirements
The solution shall support:
•
Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
•
Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
•
Audit Logging
•
Data Encryption
•
Privacy Controls
4
6. Non-Functional Requirements
Availability
99.95% Availability
Scalability
Support Multiple Hospitals
Performance
Real-Time Access to Patient Information
Reliability
Disaster Recovery Support
7. Deliverables
1. Hospital Management Platform
2. Patient Portal
3. Mobile Application
4. Analytics Dashboard
5. Integration Services
6. Documentation
7. Training Materials
8. Project Timeline
Phase
Duration

1 Month
Design
1 Month

Integration

Deployment
1 Month
5
Total Duration: 10 Months
9. Vendor Qualifications
Minimum 5 years healthcare IT experience
Hospital system implementation experience
Certified healthcare technology specialists
. Government project experience
10. Financial Requirements
Estimated Budget:
SAR 4,500,000
11. Evaluation Criteria
Criteria

50%

Technical Proposal
Smart Hospital Management System
Submitted To: Ministry of Health (MOH)
Submitted By: NextGen Healthcare IT
Proposal Reference: NGH-MOH-2026-002
Submission Date: June 2026
1. Executive Summary
NextGen Healthcare IT is proud to submit our comprehensive proposal in response to RFP MOH-
RFP-2026-001. We understand the Ministry of Health's objective to unify fragmented systems,
eliminate manual processes, and transform patient care through digital innovation. Our Cloud-
Native Smart Hospital Management System is purpose-built to automate clinical and administrative
workflows, ensuring a seamless experience for patients and optimized resource utilization for
healthcare providers.
2. Proposed Scope of Work & Modules
Our solution fully aligns with the functional requirements outlined in the RFP, covering all critical
hospital operations.
2.1 Patient & Appointment Management
•
Patient Portal & EMR: Unified Electronic Medical Records, secure patient portal access, and
complete medical history tracking.
•
Intelligent Scheduling: Real-time online booking, waitlist automation, SMS/Email appointment
reminders, and physician availability management.
2.2 Clinical & Pharmacy Systems
•
Clinical Documentation: Standardized treatment plans, diagnosis management, and seamless
integration with LIS (Laboratory) and RIS (Radiology).
•
Pharmacy Automation: Automated prescription processing, real-time inventory tracking, and
intelligent drug interaction alerts to ensure patient safety.
2.3 Billing & Financial Management
•
Insurance & Claims: Automated insurance claims processing, billing management, and patient
payment tracking.
. Financial Reporting: Daily revenue monitoring and reconciliation dashboards.
2.4 Advanced Reporting & Analytics
. Executive Dashboards: High-level KPI monitoring for hospital administration.
. Regulatory Reporting: Automated compliance reports aligned with MOH standards.
3. Technical & Security Architecture
We leverage cutting-edge cloud infrastructure to deliver a highly available, scalable, and secure
platform.
. Cloud Platform: Hosted on scalable cloud infrastructure with 99.95% Guaranteed Availability.
Integrations: API-first architecture enabling seamless data exchange with existing LIS, RIS,
and Government Health Platforms.
. Security: Implementation of Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), Role-Based Access Control
(RBAC), end-to-end data encryption, and comprehensive audit logging.
4. Project Implementation Timeline
Our project plan strictly adheres to the requested 10-month delivery schedule.
